text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: What're w'doing f'train'n t'day? Th'usual's p'fectly fine f'me.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huh? What's w'th'face? D'I say some'n weird?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: This can't b'happen'n! I'm s'posed t'be turn'n 'nto a city girl!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She must be feeling tired from all the consecutive races. I should probably rethink her schedule moving forward.
